Collaboration with the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation ensured accurate documentation of red hand stencils and stone artifacts.
summary: Researchers utilized drone technology to discover three previously unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in the Blue Mountains region, revealing significant cultural heritage. Collaboration with the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation ensured accurate documentation of red hand stencils and stone artifacts.
why_it_matters: This innovative approach may improve archaeological surveys in difficult-to-navigate areas, thereby preserving cultural heritage.

title: Muhammad Ali’s former training camp restored for $1m and reopened as museum
content: Mike Madden's dedication to preserving sports history shines brightly as he invests $1.5 million into restoring Fighter's Heaven, the legendary training camp originally founded by Muhammad Ali in 1972. title: Goodwill listed gold Lego piece from $14.95; rare mask later sold for $18,101
